        "contents": "# Page Transition Implementation Techniques\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document explains the techniques and optimizations used in &#96;MPAPageTransition.js&#96; to ensure seamless page transitions without visual flashes or broken images.\n\n## Key Problem: Race Condition Between CSS and JavaScript\n\n**The Challenge:**\n- Page HTML loads → CSS renders → Overlay starts at &#96;opacity: 0&#96; (default)\n- JavaScript runs → Sets overlay to &#96;opacity: 1&#96; \n- **Gap between CSS render and JavaScript execution** → Page content (blue background) flashes through\n\n**The Solution:**\nSet overlay to &#96;opacity: 1&#96; by default in CSS, eliminating the race condition entirely.\n\n## Technique 1: CSS-First Visibility (Eliminates Race Condition)\n\n**Location:** &#96;styles/components/_page-transitions.scss&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;scss\n.page-transition-overlay {\n  opacity: 1; /* Visible by default to cover page content immediately */\n  /* ... */\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it works:**\n- Overlay is visible **immediately** when HTML loads (before JavaScript runs)\n- No gap between page render and overlay visibility\n- Prevents blue/white background flash completely\n\n**Trade-off:**\n- Overlay is visible by default, so we must explicitly hide it when not navigating\n- This is handled in &#96;MPAPageTransition.initialize()&#96; when &#96;!isPageNavigating&#96;\n\n## Technique 2: Crossorigin Matching for Cache Usage\n\n**Location:** Multiple places in &#96;MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nimageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it's critical:**\n- HTML &#96;&lt;link rel=\"preload\"&gt;&#96; uses &#96;crossorigin=\"anonymous\"&#96;\n- If &#96;&lt;img&gt;&#96; tag doesn't match, browser treats them as different resources\n- Result: Preloaded image is ignored, causing network request and flash\n\n**Where applied:**\n- &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; - When restoring image from sessionStorage\n- &#96;updateTransitionOverlay()&#96; - When updating overlay for navigation\n- &#96;initialize()&#96; - When setting up image element\n\n## Technique 3: Preventing Stale sessionStorage Overwrites\n\n**Location:** &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; method\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst htmlHasValidImage = imageElement.src &amp;&amp; \n                          ",

        "contents": "/**\n * Link transitions that animate between pages\n */\nexport class PageTransition {\n  constructor() {\n    this.timelines = [];\n  }\n\n  async showPageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const transitionTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      transitionTimeline\n        .to(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          duration: 1.25,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        })\n        .set(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          delay: .5,\n        });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async hidePageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const hideTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      // ✅ CRITICAL: Animate the main element FIRST at position 0\n      // This ensures it always animates even if child elements don't exist\n      hideTimeline.to(\n        element,\n        {\n          opacity: 0,\n          duration: 1,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        },\n        0\n      ); // Position 0 = start immediately\n    });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "this.gsap.to(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n  opacity: 0,\n  duration: 0.6,\n  delay: 0.5,\n  ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why removed scaleY:**\n- &#96;scaleY&#96; creates vertical slide animation\n- Not needed for fade transitions\n- Simpler animation = better performance\n- Overlay covers full viewport regardless of scaleY\n\n## Summary of Techniques\n\n| Technique | Purpose | Impact |\n|----------|---------|--------|\n| CSS &#96;opacity: 1&#96;         "contents": "await new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it's needed:**\n- &#96;complete: true&#96; means image data is loaded, but browser might not have painted it yet\n- Reading &#96;offsetHeight&#96; forces layout calculation\n- &#96;requestAnimationFrame&#96; ensures paint completes before next operation\n- Without this: Image data loaded but not painted → overlay shows but image appears blank/flash\n\n**Note:** With CSS &#96;opacity: 1&#96; by default, this is less critical but still ensures image is painted before overlay becomes visible.\n\n## Technique 6: Fallback Image Loading When Preloader Doesn't Run\n\n**Location:** &#96;initialize()&#96; method (when NOT navigating)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nif (!Preloader.shouldShow()) {\n  await this.loadPageImages();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it's needed:**\n- Preloader only runs on first visit (&#96;!sessionStorage.getItem('preloaderShown')&#96;)\n- On reload, preloader doesn't run → page images never get loaded\n- This fallback ensures images load even when preloader skips\n\n**Flow:**\n1. Hard refresh → Preloader runs → Images loaded ✅\n2. Reload → Preloader doesn't run → &#96;loadPageImages()&#96; runs → Images loaded ✅\n3. Navigation → Preloader doesn't run → &#96;hideTransition()&#96; calls &#96;loadPageImages()&#96; → Images loaded ✅\n\n## Technique 7: Await hideTransition to Prevent Content Flash\n\n**Location:** &#96;initialize()&#96; method\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nawait this.hideTransition();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it's needed:**\n- &#96;hideTransition()&#96; is async (fades out overlay)\n- Without &#96;await&#96;, &#96;initialize()&#96; returns immediately\n- Page content becomes visible before overlay finishes hiding → text flash\n- With &#96;await&#96;, overlay fully hides before page content shows\n\n## Technique 8: Simple Fade In/Out (No scaleY)\n\n**Location:** &#96;showTransition()&#96; and &#96;hideTransition()&#96; methods\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Fade in\nthis.gsap.to(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n  opacity: 1,\n  duration: 0.6,\n  ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n});\n\n// Fade out\nthis.gsap.to(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n  opacity: 0,\n  duration: 0.6,",

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async showTransition() {\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n        resolve();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Set initial state: hidden (opacity: 0)\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n        opacity: 0,\n      });\n      \n      // Fade in to visible (opacity: 1)\n      this.gsap.to(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n        opacity: 1,\n        duration: 0.6,\n        ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        onComplete: resolve,\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async hideTransition() {\n    await this.loadPageImages();\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/pre-generate_transition_overlay_markup_at_build_time_f3eae7ec.plan.md",

        "contents": "---\nname: \"\"\noverview: \"\"\ntodos: []\nisProject: false\n---\n\n## Problem Analysis\n\n**Current Issue**: Flash of new page content before transition overlay markup is updated via JavaScript, causing visual glitches.\n\n**Root Cause**: In MPA, each page loads fresh HTML. The overlay markup is static (hardcoded in partial), then JavaScript tries to update it after page load, creating a race condition.\n\n**Solution**: Pre-generate the correct transition overlay markup for each page during build time, so the HTML already contains the right image and alt text when the page loads.\n\n## Benefits of Build-Time Approach\n\n1. **No Race Conditions**: Markup is correct from the start\n2. **No Flash**: Overlay has correct content immediately\n3. **Simpler Runtime Code**: No DOM manipulation needed for markup\n4. **Better Performance**: No JavaScript needed to update overlay content\n5. **More Reliable**: Works even if JavaScript fails or is slow\n6. **MPA-Optimized**: Each page is self-contained with correct markup\n\n## Implementation Steps\n\n### Step 1: Add Transition Data to Template Data\n\n**File**: &#96;scripts/generate-static-pages.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- In the loop where &#96;templateData&#96; is built, add transition data from &#96;routeConfig.transition&#96;\n- Pass &#96;transitionImage&#96; and &#96;transitionAlt&#96; to template (no copy text)\n- Handle case where route doesn't have transition data (fallback to defaults)\n\n**Code location**: Around line 210-228 where &#96;templateData&#96; is populated\n\n### Step 2: Update page-transition.html Partial\n\n**File**: &#96;views/partials/page-transition.html&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- Replace hardcoded image &#96;src&#96; with &#96;{{ transitionImage }}&#96; or fallback\n- Replace hardcoded &#96;alt&#96; with &#96;{{ transitionAlt }}&#96; or fallback\n- Use Nunjucks conditionals to handle missing data gracefully\n\n**Current hardcoded values**:\n\n- Image: &#96;\"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp\"&#96;\n- Alt: &#96;\"The Shea Memorandum Logo\"&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Simplify MPAPageTransition.js\n\n**File**: &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener(\"click\", async (event) =&gt; {\n      const target = event.target;\n      if (!target) return;\n      const link = target.closest(\"a\");\n      if (!link) return;\n\n      const href = link.getAttribute(\"href\");\n      const isBlockedLink =\n        href &amp;&amp;\n        this.blocklistLinks.some((blockedLink) =&gt;\n          href.startsWith(blockedLink),\n        );\n      if (isBlockedLink) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // prevent same page navigation\n      if (this.isSamePage(href)) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        this.closeMenuIfOpen();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // animate transition to new page\n      if (!href) return;\n      event.preventDefault();\n\n      // Ensure overlay element is available\n      if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n        this.elements.transitionOverlay = document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\");\n        if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n          console.warn('Transition overlay not found, navigating without transition');\n          window.location.href = href;\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n        \n        if (route &amp;&amp; this.siteConfig) {\n          // 2. Update overlay with transition data\n          await this.updateTransitionOverlay(route);\n          \n          // 3. Store transition data in sessionStorage\n          const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n          if (routeConfig &amp;&amp; routeConfig.transition) {\n            this.storeTransitionData(routeConfig.transition);\n          }\n        }\n\n        await this.showTransition();\n        \n        // 5. Navigate to new page\n        this.sessionStorage.setItem(\"pageTransition\", \"true\");\n        window.location.href = href;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error in page transition:', error);\n        // Fallback: navigate without transition\n        window.location.href = href;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  async showTransition() {\n    return new Promise\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync initialize() {\n\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      const imageAfterRestore = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageAfterRestore &amp;&amp; imageAfterRestore.src) {\n        imageAfterRestore.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        if (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n          await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n        }\n        \n        void imageAfterRestore.offsetHeight;\n        await new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n      }\n      \n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      await this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Initial state: overlay hidden\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        opacity: 0\n      });\n      \n      // Ensure crossorigin is set for future use\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; imageElement.src) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n      }\n      \n      // If preloader didn't run, load page images now\n      // Preloader only runs on first visit (when 'preloaderShown' doesn't exist)\n      // On reload, preloader doesn't run, so we need to load images here\n      if (!Preloader.shouldShow()) {\n        await this.loadPageImages();\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async hideTransition() {\n    await this.loadPageImages();\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n        resolve();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n        opacity: 1,\n      });\n      \n      this.gsap.to(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n        opacity: 0,\n        duration: 0.6,\n        delay: 0.5,\n        ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        onComplete: resolve,\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Normalize href to SiteConfig route key\n   * Converts various href formats to consistent route keys\n   * @param {string} href - Link href (e.g., \"/\", \"/introduction\", \"introduction\", \"/index.html\")\n   * @returns {string|null} - Normalized route key or null if not found\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        const fallbackImage = 'https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp';\n        const htmlHasValidImage = imageElement.src &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== '' &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== fallbackImage;\n        const imageMatchesSessionStorage = imageElement.src === transitionData.image;\n        \n        if (htmlHasValidImage &amp;&amp; !imageMatchesSessionStorage) {\n          this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n          return;\n        }\n        \n        const imageAlreadyCorrect = imageMatchesSessionStorage &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.complete &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.naturalHeight &gt; 0;\n        \n        if (!imageAlreadyCorrect)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; // Match preload link crossorigin\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      // Ensure crossorigin matches preload link\n      imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "},\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### How Transitions Work\n\n1. **On Page Hide**: \n   - &#96;TransitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay()&#96; updates the overlay with the next page's transition data\n   - Image is preloaded if not already cached\n   - &#96;showPageTransition()&#96; animates the overlay in\n\n2. **On Page Show**:\n   - &#96;hidePageTransition()&#96; animates the overlay out\n   - Page content is revealed\n\n### Transition Image Preloading\n\nTransition images are automatically preloaded:\n- During browser idle time (via &#96;requestIdleCallback&#96;)\n- Before showing transition (if not already preloaded)\n- Cached in &#96;TransitionsManager.preloadedImageUrls&#96; Set\n\n### Customizing Transition Animation\n\nEdit &#96;app/animations/PageTransition.js&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nasync showPageTransition(element) {\n  // Customize the show animation\n  const timeline = gsap.timeline({\n    onComplete: () =&gt; resolve(),\n  });\n\n  timeline.to(element, {\n    opacity: 1,\n    duration: 0.3,  // Adjust duration\n    ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n  });\n  \n  // Add more animation steps...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Disabling Transitions\n\nTo disable transitions for a specific page:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// In your Page class\nasync hide(route) {\n  // Skip transition\n  await this.beforeHide?.();\n  this.destroy();\n  await this.afterHide?.();\n}\n\nasync show() {\n  await this.beforeShow?.();\n  // Skip transition hide\n  this.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, { immediate: true });\n  await this.afterShow?.();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Authoring Page Animations\n\n### Using Lifecycle Hooks\n\nPage lifecycle hooks allow you to add animations at specific points:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nexport class MyPage extends Page {\n  async beforeCreate() {\n    // Animate page container in",

        "contents": "**Location:** &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; method\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst htmlHasValidImage = imageElement.src &amp;&amp; \n                          imageElement.src !== '' &amp;&amp; \n                          imageElement.src !== fallbackImage;\nconst imageMatchesSessionStorage = imageElement.src === transitionData.image;\n\nif (htmlHasValidImage &amp;&amp; !imageMatchesSessionStorage) {\n  // Don't overwrite correct HTML image with stale sessionStorage data\n  this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n  return;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it's needed:**\n- HTML has correct image from build-time generation\n- sessionStorage might have stale image from previous navigation\n- Without this check, correct image gets overwritten → flash\n\n**Example scenario:**\n1. User visits &#96;/references&#96; → sessionStorage stores &#96;home-theme-desktop.webp&#96;\n2. User navigates to &#96;/section-3&#96; → HTML has &#96;section-3-desktop.webp&#96; (correct)\n3. Without check: sessionStorage overwrites HTML image → wrong image flashes\n4. With check: HTML image is preserved → correct image displays\n\n## Technique 4: Image Readiness Check Before Setting src\n\n**Location:** &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; method\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst imageAlreadyCorrect = imageMatchesSessionStorage &amp;&amp; \n                           imageElement.complete &amp;&amp; \n                           imageElement.naturalHeight &gt; 0;\n\nif (imageAlreadyCorrect) {\n  // Skip unnecessary work - image is already loaded and correct\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Why it's needed:**\n- Prevents redundant &#96;src&#96; assignment\n- Setting &#96;src&#96; on an already-loaded image can trigger re-render\n- &#96;complete&#96; + &#96;naturalHeight &gt; 0&#96; confirms image is fully loaded and painted\n\n## Technique 5: Force Browser Paint Before Overlay Visibility\n\n**Location:** &#96;initialize()&#96; method (when navigating)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nif (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n  await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n}\n\n// Force browser to paint the image\nvoid imageAfterRestore.offsetHeight; // Force layout calculation\nawait new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/pre-generate_transition_overlay_markup_at_build_time_f3eae7ec.plan.md",

        "contents": "&lt;section id=\"page-transition-overlay-templates\"&gt;&lt;/section&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### MPAPageTransition.js Simplification\n\n**Remove**:\n\n- &#96;updateTransitionOverlay()&#96; method\n- &#96;storeTransitionData()&#96; method  \n- &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; method\n- All calls to these methods\n\n**Keep**:\n\n- &#96;normalizeHrefToRoute()&#96; - still useful for route validation\n- &#96;showTransition()&#96; - animation logic\n- &#96;hideTransition()&#96; - animation logic\n- &#96;loadPageImages()&#96; - still needed for page images\n\n**Simplify &#96;setupListeners()&#96;**:\n\n- Remove overlay update logic\n- Remove sessionStorage storage\n- Just normalize route (for validation), show transition, navigate\n\n**Simplify &#96;initialize()&#96;**:\n\n- Remove &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; call\n- Just handle hide animation when &#96;isPageNavigating&#96; is true\n\n## Flow Comparison\n\n### Before (Runtime Update):\n\n1. Page loads with default overlay markup\n2. JavaScript runs, updates overlay markup\n3. Flash of default content visible\n4. Show transition animation\n5. Navigate\n\n### After (Build-Time):\n\n1. Page loads with correct overlay markup (already in HTML)\n2. Show transition animation (markup already correct)\n3. Navigate\n4. New page loads with its own correct overlay markup\n\n## Files to Modify\n\n1. &#96;scripts/generate-static-pages.js&#96; - Add transition data to templateData\n2. &#96;views/partials/page-transition.html&#96; - Use template variables instead of hardcoded values\n3. &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96; - Remove markup update methods, simplify logic\n\n## Notes\n\n- **Backward Compatibility**: Use Nunjucks &#96;or&#96; operator for fallbacks\n- **Default Values**: Keep current defaults as fallback if route has no transition data\n- **Animation Still Needed**: We still need GSAP animations for show/hide, just no DOM manipulation\n- **sessionStorage**: Can remove &#96;pageTransitionImage&#96; storage, but keep &#96;pageTransition&#96; flag for navigation detection",
        "signatures": {},

(lines 141-161)\n- ✅ **Crossorigin matching** (&#96;imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'&#96;) - Critical for cache usage\n- ✅ **Image readiness checks** in &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; (lines 80-84)\n- ✅ **Force paint logic** in &#96;initialize()&#96; ## Summary of Changes

### Phase 1: Removed redundant opacity sets in animation functions

1. `showTransition()` (lines 330-331)
   - Removed: `gsap.set(opacity: 0)` before fade-in
   - Reason: CSS already sets `opacity: 1` by default
   - Kept: Fade-in animation

2. `hideTransition()` (lines 350-351)
   - Removed: `gsap.set(opacity: 1)` before fade-out
   - Reason: CSS already sets `opacity: 1` by default
   - Kept: Fade-out animation

### Phase 2: Updated `initialize()` opacity management

3. `initialize()` non-navigating case (lines 234-236)
   - Kept: `gsap.set(opacity: 0)` to hide overlay on initial load
   - Updated comment to explain why it's needed despite CSS `opacity: 1`

### Phase 3: Clarified force paint logic

4. Force paint logic (lines 227-229)
   - Kept: Force paint logic (`offsetHeight` + `requestAnimationFrame`)
   - Updated comment to explain its purpose with the CSS fix

## What Was Preserved

- Image preloading functions (`loadPageImages`, `updateTransitionOverlay`, `restoreTransitionData`)
- SessionStorage management for image caching
- Crossorigin matching for browser cache usage
- Image readiness checks and wait logic
- All navigation and utility functions

## Testing Checklist

Test the following scenarios:
- Hard refresh → Preloader runs → Images load → No flash
- Reload page → Preloader doesn't run → Images still load → No broken images
- Navigate between pages → Transition images display correctly → Smooth fade in/out
- Navigate to unvisited page → Correct image displays → No blank/flash
- Navigate after visiting `/references` → Correct page image (not stale) → No wrong image flash
- Initial page load (non-navigating) → Overlay hidden → No flash of overlay

All todos are complete. The code is cleaner while preserving image preloading and caching functionality.

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Check if an image URL has been preloaded\n   * @param {string} url - Image URL to check\n   * @returns {boolean} True if the image URL is in the preloaded set\n   * @example\n   * if (transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n   *   Image is already cached\n   * }\n   */\n  isImagePreloaded(url) {\n    return this.imageLoader.isImagePreloaded(url);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * Uses ImageService for consistent behavior\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   * @example\n   * const img = document.querySelector('img[data-src]');\n   * await transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(img);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize preloading strategy for transition images\n   * Uses requestIdleCallback when available, otherwise falls back to setTimeout\n   * Preloading happens during browser idle time to avoid blocking main thread\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  initializePreloading() {\n    // Preload during idle time\n    if (\"requestIdleCallback\" in window) {\n      requestIdleCallback(() =&gt; {\n        this.preloadAllTransitionImages();\n      });\n    } else {\n      // Fallback for browsers without requestIdleCallback\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        this.preloadAllTransitionImages();\n      }, 2000);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Extract all image elements from transition templates\n   * @returns {HTMLImageElement[]} Array of image elements with data-src attributes\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nconstructor({ siteConfig }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n  async init() {\n    // Helper function to perform initialization\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      whenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n        this.pageTransition = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_OVERLAY);\n        this.transitionTemplates = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_TEMPLATES);\n\n        this.setupTransitionTemplates();\n        this.initializePreloading();\n        resolve();\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { ImageService } from \"../utilities/ImageService.js\";\nimport { whenDOMReady } from \"../utilities/AsyncHelpers.js\";\nimport { $ } from \"../utilities/DOMHelpers.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\n\n/**\n * TransitionsManager class for managing the transition overlay\n * Handles the transition overlay templates and preloading of images\n * Manages the transition overlay elements\n */\nexport class TransitionsManager {\n  /**\n   * Creates a new TransitionsManager instance\n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {import(\"../config/SiteConfig.js\").SiteConfig} options.siteConfig - Site configuration containing route and transition data\n   */\n  constructor({ siteConfig }) {\n    this.siteConfig = siteConfig;\n    this.imageLoader = new ImageService();\n    this.pageTransition = null;\n    this.transitionTemplates = null;\n    this.transitionAnimations = new PageTransition();\n    // * Note: Don't call init() here - let App call it when DOM is ready\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; // Match preload link crossorigin\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      // Ensure crossorigin matches preload link\n      imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync restoreTransitionData() {\n\n        \n        if (!imageAlreadyCorrect) {\n          const isPreloaded = this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(transitionData.image);\n          \n          if (isPreloaded) {\n            imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n          } else {\n            const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n            tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', transitionData.image);\n            tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n            if (this.transitionsManager) {\n              await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n            } else {\n              await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n            }\n            imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n          }\n          \n          if (transitionData.alt) {\n            imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error restoring transition data:', error);\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync initialize() {\n\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      const imageAfterRestore = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageAfterRestore &amp;&amp; imageAfterRestore.src) {\n        imageAfterRestore.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        if (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n          await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n        }\n        \n        // Force browser to paint the image before overlay animation\n        // Even with CSS opacity: 1 by default, we need to ensure image is painted\n        // to prevent blank image flash when overlay is visible\n        void imageAfterRestore.offsetHeight;\n        await new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n      }\n      \n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      await this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Hide overlay immediately on initial page load (non-navigating case)\n      // CSS has opacity: 1 by default to prevent race condition, so we must hide it here\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        opacity: 0\n      });\n      \n      // Ensure crossorigin is set for future use\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; imageElement.src) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n      }\n      \n      // If preloader didn't run, load page images now\n      // Preloader only runs on first visit (when 'preloaderShown' doesn't exist)\n      // On reload, preloader doesn't run, so we need to load images here\n      if (!Preloader.shouldShow()) {\n        await this.loadPageImages();\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Extract all image elements from transition templates\n   * @returns {HTMLImageElement[]} Array of image elements with data-src attributes\n   */\n  getAllTransitionImageElements() {\n    const images = [];\n\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) return images;\n\n    const templates = this.transitionTemplates.querySelectorAll(SELECTORS.TEMPLATE);\n\n    templates.forEach((template) =&gt; {\n      const img = template.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n      if (img &amp;&amp; img.dataset.src) {\n        images.push(img);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return images;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload all transition images during idle time using ImageService\n   * Images are decoded for layout-ready rendering\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when all images are preloaded (or failed)\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Page Transition Class for MPA\n *\n * @description: This class is responsible for the page transition animation in a Multi-Page Application.\n * @author: CodeGrid\n * @version: 1.0.0\n * @since: 2026-01-21\n */\nimport { ImageService } from '../utilities/ImageService.js';\nimport { Preloader } from '../components/Preloader.js';\n\nexport class MPAPageTransition {\n  constructor({ siteConfig, transitionsManager }) {\n    this.gsap = window.gsap;\n    this.sessionStorage = window.sessionStorage;\n    this.isPageNavigating = false;\n    this.blocklistLinks = [\"http\", \"mailto:\", \"tel:\"];\n    this.elements = {};\n    this.imageService = new ImageService();\n    this.siteConfig = siteConfig;\n    this.transitionsManager = transitionsManager;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load all page images including navigation overlay background\n   * Uses ImageService to load all images with data-src attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        const fallbackImage = 'https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp';\n        const htmlHasValidImage = imageElement.src &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== '' &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== fallbackImage;\n        const imageMatchesSessionStorage = imageElement.src === transitionData.image;\n        \n        if (htmlHasValidImage &amp;&amp; !imageMatchesSessionStorage) {\n          this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n          return;\n        }\n        \n        const imageAlreadyCorrect = imageMatchesSessionStorage &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.complete &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.naturalHeight &gt; 0;\n        \n        if (!imageAlreadyCorrect)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync initialize() {\n (!Preloader.shouldShow()) {\n        await this.loadPageImages();\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener(\"click\", async (event) =&gt; {\n      const target = event.target;\n      if (!target) return;\n      const link = target.closest(\"a\");\n      if (!link) return;\n\n      const href = link.getAttribute(\"href\");\n      const isBlockedLink =\n        href &amp;&amp;\n        this.blocklistLinks.some((blockedLink) =&gt;\n          href.startsWith(blockedLink),\n        );\n      if (isBlockedLink) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // prevent same page navigation\n      if (this.isSamePage(href)) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        this.closeMenuIfOpen();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // animate transition to new page\n      if (!href) return;\n      event.preventDefault();\n\n      // Ensure overlay element is available\n      if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n        this.elements.transitionOverlay = document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\");\n        if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n          console.warn('Transition overlay not found, navigating without transition');\n          window.location.href = href;\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n        \n        if (route &amp;&amp; this.siteConfig) {\n          // 2. Update overlay with transition data\n          await this.updateTransitionOverlay(route);\n          \n          // 3. Store transition data in sessionStorage\n          const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n          if (routeConfig &amp;&amp; routeConfig.transition) {\n            this.storeTransitionData(routeConfig.transition);\n          }\n        }\n\n        await this.showTransition();\n        \n        // 5. Navigate to new page\n        this.sessionStorage.setItem(\"pageTransition\", \"true\");\n        window.location.href = href;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error in page transition:', error);\n        // Fallback: navigate without transition\n        window.location.href = href;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nsetupTransitionTemplates() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a transition template HTML string for a given route\n   * @param {string} route - The route identifier (e.g., \"home\", \"section-1\")\n   * @param {Object} data - Route configuration data from siteConfig\n   * @param {Object} data.transition - Transition configuration\n   * @param {string} data.transition.copy - Text to display during transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.image - Image URL for the transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.alt - Alt text for the transition image\n   * @returns {string} HTML template string with transition markup\n   * \n   * Removed:\n   * &lt;p class=\"page-transition-overlay__copy\"&gt;${data.transition.copy}&lt;/p&gt;\n   */\n  createTransitionTemplate(route, data) {\n    return &#96;&lt;template ${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"&gt;\n      &lt;img\n        class=\"page-transition-overlay__image\"\n        ${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC}=\"${data.transition.image}\"\n        alt=\"${data.transition.alt}\"\n      /&gt;\n    &lt;/template&gt;&#96;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize preloading strategy for transition images\n   * Uses requestIdleCallback when available, otherwise falls back to setTimeout\n   * Preloading happens during browser idle time to avoid blocking main thread\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  setupTransitionTemplates() {\n    let transitionTemplates = document.createDocumentFragment();\n\n    for (const [route, data] of Object.entries(this.siteConfig.settings)) {\n      let template = this.createTransitionTemplate(route, data);\n      transitionTemplates.appendChild(\n        new DOMParser()\n          .parseFromString(template, \"text/html\")\n          .querySelector(SELECTORS.TEMPLATE)\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Replace all children with the templates from the fragment\n    // Using spread operator to extract all children from the DocumentFragment\n    // This explicitly moves all template elements into the DOM\n    this.transitionTemplates.replaceChildren(...transitionTemplates.children);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a transition template HTML string for a given route\n   * @param {string} route - The route identifier (e.g., \"home\", \"section-1\")\n   * @param {Object} data - Route configuration data from siteConfig\n   * @param {Object} data.transition - Transition configuration\n   * @param {string} data.transition.copy - Text to display during transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.image - Image URL for the transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.alt - Alt text for the transition image\n   * @returns {string} HTML template string with transition markup\n   * \n   * Removed:\n   * &lt;p class=\"page-transition-overlay__copy\"&gt;${data.transition.copy}&lt;/p&gt;\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class PreloaderAnimation {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Create and run the preloader animation\n   * @param {Object} options - Animation configuration\n   * @param {HTMLElement} options.preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @param {NodeList|Array} options.copyElements - The copy/text elements to animate\n   * @param {Function} options.onComplete - Callback when animation completes\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n  async create({ preloaderElement, copyElements, onComplete }) {\n    // Wait for fonts to load to prevent FOUT (Flash of Unstyled Text)\n    await document.fonts.ready;\n\n    // Reset any existing animation first\n    if (this.timeline) {\n      this.remove();\n    }\n\n    // Validate elements exist\n    if (!preloaderElement) {\n      console.warn('PreloaderAnimation: preloaderElement is required');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const elementsArray = normalizeToArray(copyElements);\n    if (elementsArray.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('PreloaderAnimation: No copy elements found');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.timeline = gsap.timeline({\n      onComplete: () =&gt; {\n        if (onComplete) {\n          onComplete();\n        }\n      },\n    });\n\n    const hasSplitText = typeof SplitText !== 'undefined';\n    \n    if (hasSplitText &amp;&amp; elementsArray.length &gt; 0) {\n      this.createSplitTextAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement);\n    } else {\n      this.createFallbackAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create animation using SplitText with mask option\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray - Array of text elements to animate\n   * @param {HTMLElement} preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { Titles } from \"./Titles.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\nimport { createError, ERROR_CODES } from \"../utilities/ErrorRegistry.js\";\n\n/**\n * AnimationsManager handles page animations lifecycle\n * - Creates single IntersectionObserver per page\n * - Auto-detects data-animation attributes\n * - Registers and tracks animation instances\n * - Kills all animations on destroy\n */\nexport class AnimationsManager {\n  constructor() {\n    this.animationRegistry = {\n      title: Titles,\n      // Future: image: Images, parallax: Parallax\n    };\n    \n    // Current page state\n    this.pageAnimations = [];\n    this.intersectionObserver = null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validates that the page element is a valid HTMLElement\n   * @param {HTMLElement} pageElement - The page container element to validate\n   * @returns {void}\n   * @throws {Error} Throws if pageElement is null, undefined, or not an HTMLElement\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found.         "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nhidePageTransition(element) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Normalizes a route string by removing leading slash\n   * Ensures consistent route format for template lookups\n   * @param {string} route - Route string that may or may not start with \"/\"\n   * @returns {string} Normalized route without leading slash\n   * @example\n   * normalizeRoute(\"/home\") // Returns \"home\"\n   * normalizeRoute(\"section-1\") // Returns \"section-1\"\n   */\n  normalizeRoute(route) {\n    if (route.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n      return route.substring(1);\n    }\n    return route;\n  }\n}",

## Summary of Changes

### 1. Added detailed comments
- Added inline comments to `updateTransitionOverlay()` explaining:
  - Lifecycle steps
  - Edge cases
  - Why each check exists
  - crossOrigin matching requirements

### 2. Extracted preload logic
- Created `ImageService.ensureTransitionImageReady()` method
- Centralizes preload check + preload logic
- Handles crossOrigin matching automatically
- Reusable across MPAPageTransition and TransitionsManager

### 3. Extracted DOM update logic
- Created `MPAPageTransition.updateOverlayImageElement()` helper method
- Separates DOM manipulation from preloading logic
- Makes code more testable and maintainable

### 4. Refactored main function
- Simplified `updateTransitionOverlay()` from ~67 lines to ~40 lines
- Reduced cyclomatic complexity from ~8 to ~4
- Now orchestrates extracted methods instead of inline logic

### 5. Updated restoreTransitionData
- Refactored to use same extracted methods for consistency
- Preserved all edge case handling (stale overwrite prevention, etc.)
